title: US Treasury Sanctions 21 Individuals and 25 Entities Tied to Los Mayos
detail: OFAC designated 21 individuals and 25 companies linked to the Los Mayos faction led by Ismael Zambada Sicairos ('Mayito Flaco'), including a Tijuana currency exchange, a private equity firm, gas stations and security firms in Baja California, accused of laundering fentanyl proceeds. Infobae reported the action on September 30; the Yucatan Times dates it October 1, so the earliest report date is used.
